description: This Java class defines a business step in the loan processing workflow that checks for overdue loan repayments and triggers overdue events when appropriate. It interacts with loan data, configuration, and event notification services to determine overdue status and notify relevant systems.

classes.name: CheckLoanRepaymentOverdueBusinessStep
classes.description: Implements a business rule to check if a loan's repayment is overdue, and if so, publishes an event.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that processes a loan object, checks its repayment schedule for overdue installments, and triggers overdue events.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns the enum style name for this business step.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name of this business step.

methods.name: isOverDueEventNeededToBeSent
methods.description: Static helper method to determine if an overdue event should be sent based on due date, current date, and outstanding amount.
